entries.text: ClickHouse server and Cloud loads now stream file bytes (CSV, CSVWithNames, Parquet) to the server's native format parsers instead of converting every row in Python; the server path uses the HTTP port (new http_port option, default 8123, or 8443 with secure). TPC-H SF0.1 CSV loading dropped from 10.3s to 0.6s, and loaded tables now match the dbgen files byte for byte, including leading and trailing whitespace the row loader used to strip.
